steps.title: Seed target cells in a 6cm dish one day prior…
steps.description: Seed target cells in a 6cm dish one day prior to infection to reach ~50% confluency.

steps.title: Add polybrene to the culture medium at a final…
steps.description: Add polybrene to the culture medium at a final concentration of 8 µg/mL.

steps.title: Add the lentivirus suspension to the cells at…
steps.description: Add the lentivirus suspension to the cells at the desired MOI (multiplicity of infection). Gently swirl the plate to ensure even distribution.

steps.title: Incubate the cells under standard culture…
steps.description: Incubate the cells under standard culture conditions (37°C, 5% CO₂) overnight.
